title: Orchid Relay
text: The Orchid Relay is a compact navigation beacon designed by engineer Mara Voss. It debuted at the Lumen Fair and is recognized by its violet signal cage.

title: Mara Voss
text: Engineer Mara Voss was born in the inland city of Selka. She later specialized in low-power navigation instruments and designed the Orchid Relay.

title: Lumen Fair
text: The annual Lumen Fair presents experimental lamps, beacons, and optical instruments. The fair rotates between the coastal cities of Vesper and Nolin.

title: Frostline Ferry
text: The Frostline Ferry runs the winter route between Nera and Oswin. Its propulsion system is the compact Kestrel Engine.

title: Kestrel Engine
text: The Kestrel Engine is powered by polished cerulean quartz held inside a silver induction ring. It was developed for the Frostline Ferry.

title: Nera
text: Nera is a northern river port known for blue-roofed warehouses and its winter ferry connection to Oswin.

title: Pineglass Prize
text: The Pineglass Prize for fiction was awarded in 2147 to Theo Marr for the novel Silent Estuary.

title: Theo Marr
text: Novelist Theo Marr published all of his travel essays under the pen name Lark Ember. His novel Silent Estuary later received the Pineglass Prize.

title: Silent Estuary
text: Silent Estuary is a novel about a tidal archivist. It was written by Theo Marr and published by Reed House.

title: Helix Garden
text: The Helix Garden is a spiral-shaped botanical park in Arvon. The Sable Institute maintains its seed collection.

title: Arvon
text: Arvon adopted the silver larch as its official city tree in 2108. The city also contains the Helix Garden and the Old North Market.

title: Sable Institute
text: The Sable Institute maintains rare alpine plants and operates field stations outside Arvon and Pel.

title: Cinder Clock
text: The Cinder Clock was invented by instrument maker Nadi Quell. Its face uses heat-darkened ceramic instead of painted numerals.

title: Nadi Quell
text: Nadi Quell studied mechanical astronomy at Umber Academy before inventing the Cinder Clock.

title: Umber Academy
text: Umber Academy teaches astronomy, precision mechanics, and archival engineering. Its observatory dome is made from black copper.

title: Juniper Array
text: The Juniper Array calibrates storm-warning buoys along the western shoals. The array was built by Oriel Works.

title: Oriel Works
text: Oriel Works was founded in 2091 by Rhea Coil. The company builds marine sensors, including the Juniper Array.

title: Rhea Coil
text: Rhea Coil was a marine engineer and the founder of Oriel Works. Her early research concerned salt-resistant sensor housings.

title: Mothwing Sonata
text: The Mothwing Sonata was composed by Ena Vale for glass harp and low flute. Its premiere took place in Corin Hall.

title: Ena Vale
text: Composer Ena Vale was born on Tern Island and trained at the Corin Conservatory. She composed the Mothwing Sonata.

title: Tern Island
text: Tern Island is a small volcanic island known for white cliffs, wind orchards, and composer Ena Vale.

title: Copper Finch Observatory
text: The Copper Finch Observatory stands on Karo Ridge and is directed by astronomer Warden Sol.

title: Karo Ridge
text: Karo Ridge is the highest ridge in the eastern basin. It hosts the Copper Finch Observatory and three weather stations.

title: Warden Sol
text: Astronomer Warden Sol directs the Copper Finch Observatory. His research tracks the rotation of pale variable stars.

title: Aster Loom
text: The Aster Loom is an automated tapestry frame engineered by Keir Dune. It uses a twelve-shuttle pattern controller.

title: Keir Dune
text: Textile engineer Keir Dune was born in Alder Fen. Dune later created the twelve-shuttle controller used by the Aster Loom.

title: Blue Salt Festival
text: The Blue Salt Festival is held every year in the month of Serein. It celebrates the reopening of the eastern salt road.

title: Red Salt Festival
text: The unrelated Red Salt Festival takes place in Highsummer and features kiln-fired sculptures.

title: Solace Tram
text: The Solace Tram was built by Brin Foundry for the steep streets of Ellor. Its first public trip occurred in 2133.

title: Brin Foundry
text: Brin Foundry builds cable cars and hillside trams. The company constructed the Solace Tram for Ellor.

title: Thistle Meridian Map
text: The Thistle Meridian Map was drawn by cartographer Jori Pell after a five-year northern survey.

title: Jori Pell
text: Cartographer Jori Pell signed field maps with the professional name North Quill, including the Thistle Meridian Map.
